steps.name: Open fixture
steps.goal: If Apple Account Verification is visible, tap Not Now. If the Home screen is visible, tap omg to open the installed app.
steps.done: The idle transcript fixture is visible.

steps.name: Idle messages keep their layout
steps.goal: Do not tap or swipe. Wait for Idle check passed or Idle check failed.
steps.done: Twenty seconds of parent updates have finished without any settled message changing height.

steps.name: Scroll through formatted replies
steps.goal: Swipe up to read later replies.
steps.done: Later reply text, lists and table content are visible.
